nom: TULA 24-7 Moisture Intense Ultra Hydrating Day & Night Cream

segments.oily: Two reviewers describe their skin as oily or oily/sensitive and report the cream absorbed well without leaving an oily feel, though one reviewer warns those with oily or combination skin should avoid it as too intense.
segments.dry: The large majority of dry-skin reviewers report strong relief from dryness, flaking and winter tightness, with skin left soft, plump and hydrated, though a few dry-skin reviewers found it instead left their skin dry or too heavy to absorb.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report good hydration during dry/winter periods without greasiness, but one combination/sensitive reviewer found it did not moisturize and worsened flaking under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and good hydration, but one sensitive/dry reviewer found it too heavy/sticky and suspected it caused breakouts, and another disliked the fragrance.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin reports it keeps skin hydrated without heaviness, calling it better than other moisturizers she has used.
segments.mature: Mature/aging-skin reviewers mostly report visible plumping and softened fine lines, though one reviewer found it insufficiently moisturizing for mature skin.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report smoother, plumper skin with reduced fine lines and forehead creases after regular use; one mature-skin reviewer felt it did not moisturize enough to address her aging concerns.
concerns.dehydration: The overwhelming majority describe significant, lasting relief from severe dryness, flaking, chapping and winter dehydration; a small minority report it dried their skin out further or felt heavy without hydrating.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports reduced redness, itching and burning, and another reports the product soothes and reduces redness generally; no dissent noted.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers credit the cream with strengthening or supporting their skin barrier and improving overall texture; no negative barrier reports found.
concerns.spots: One rosacea-prone reviewer reports the cream kept tiny pimples and spots away; no other spot-specific reports.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers using tretinoin or prescription acne treatment report the cream balanced their skin without causing breakouts; conversely, one reviewer reports new little bumps and breakouts appearing within days.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers, including some with oily or combination skin, report the cream does not feel oily or greasy and absorbs well; one reviewer advises against use for oily/combination skin, calling it too intense.

extraits.texte: I chose this for a FFF box. I struggle with redness, tiny pimples, itching and burning on my cheeks and forehead from rosecea. I applied this after my HA serum and it kept my itching, burning and spots away every day I used it. My skin felt so plump and hydrated, with slightly reduced redness. I'm saving up to put this amazing cream again. The texture is thick, but absorbed well. Love it a lot!!

I have dry, sensitive skin and am starting to worry about the effects of aging. I hoped this would be my holy grail. Despite being non-comodegenic, I think it broke me out. It was too heavy/sticky for me/my husband to try it more than a couple times

I have combination, sensitive skin. I generally use a light weight moisturizer daily after showering and sometimes at night when I actually bother to wash my face. It's always worked great but I was experiencing a little bit of dryness so I decided to try this. It didn't irritate my skin at any point but it also didn't moisturize my skin. Trying to wear makeup only magnifies the dryness/flaking (and it's a hydrating CC cream).

I've been using this moisturizer during the winter, and it's been a lifesaver for my combination, but mostly dry skin. The texture is rich but absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated all day without any greasiness. I love that it supports my skin barrier, especially with the harsh cold air. It works beautifully under makeup and has noticeably improved my skin's texture. (Gifted by Tula!)

I am 42 and perimenopausal. In the winter especially my skin gets super dry in my t zone and on my chin. I started using ultra hydrating day & night cream and it made a huge difference!! I use it every night, and some mornings. It's also good for "touch ups" during the spring and fall seasons. It's not heavy or greasy and absorbs well. This combined with the hydrating mask twice a week is perfect!!

I use tretinoin for acne which dries out my skin and makes it volatile. But not anymore - this moisturizer balances my skin without causing breakouts. I use this at night and use the regular 24/7 moisturizing cream during the day. It's the perfect way to approach my day/ night routine. My skin has never been so calm, and I can use the tretinoin on a daily basis.
I have very oily sensitive skin and I love this for my nighttime moisturizer in the winter! It gives my skin the umph it needs in the dry winter months. It's so smooth and feels amazing on my skin!
